# WindSkills — Complete Technical & Product Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Official AI-readable documentation for **WindSkills** ([https://windskills.dev](https://windskills.dev/)). Designed & engineered by **Phong** (Sherman, TX).

## 1. Overview & Problem Solved
Meta strictly prohibits personal Facebook profile publishing via the official Graph API, and traditional headless Playwright/Selenium bots fail on Facebook due to login walls, OS file-picker dialogs, and Meta's proprietary Lexical rich-text editor traps.
**WindSkills** provides deterministic, production-grade `SKILL.md` packages for **Claude Code**, **OpenAI Codex**, and **Google Antigravity** that control a persistent, logged-in **BrowserOS Neo** instance over Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## 3. Installation & Quickstart (60 Seconds)
1. Purchase and download the `.zip` package from [Gumroad](https://windcvs.gumroad.com/l/facebook-agent-skills-pack).
2. Extract the skill folder(s) into your AI agent's skills directory:
   - **Claude Code:** `~/.claude/skills/`
   - **Google Antigravity:** `~/.gemini/config/skills/`
   - **OpenAI Codex / Cursor:** Project `.agents/skills/` or global skills directory.
3. Connect **BrowserOS Neo** via MCP and invoke the skill in natural language or CLI.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Do I need a Meta Developer App or Graph API token?** No. Executes directly inside your authenticated local browser profile via BrowserOS Neo MCP.
- **How are media files uploaded without OS popups?** High-resolution images and MP4 videos are streamed directly into Chrome's memory buffer via Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP).
- **How does WindSkills prevent account flags?** Every action uses human velocity modeling (1.5s–3.0s randomized delays) and explicit Lexical state verification before publishing.

## 5. Technical Comparison: WindSkills vs. Meta Graph API vs. Raw Playwright

| Capability | WindSkills + BrowserOS Neo MCP | Meta Graph API | Raw Headless Playwright |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Personal Facebook Profile Posting** | Supported (Full Timeline, Reels, GIF, Carousel) | Blocked by Meta Policy | Frequent checkpoint / 2FA lockouts |
| **App Review & Developer Tokens** | Zero API keys or app reviews required | Mandatory business verification & 60-day token rotation | Requires storing plaintext credentials/cookies |
| **Media Upload (Photos, Videos, 9:16 Reels)** | Direct CDP memory buffer stream (Zero OS file dialogs) | Restricted endpoints & strict rate limits | Brittle `<input type="file">` selectors |
| **Meta Lexical Editor Compatibility** | Deterministic focus & state verification | Not applicable | Fails on React/Lexical synthetic events |
| **Anti-Bot Velocity Defense** | Randomized human pacing (1.5s–3.0s delays) | Server-side API calls | Instant robotic execution speed |
